name: ControlBench
description: ControlBench is a benchmark dataset designed to evaluate the problem-solving abilities of large language models on undergraduate-level control engineering problems, reflecting the breadth, depth, and complexity of classical control design.
reputation: A niche but credible benchmark in control engineering that is mainly used for evaluating LLM reasoning on undergraduate-level control problems.
notes: Evaluations conducted by human experts; focuses on classical control design problems.
